1800.meaning1: eight sincere praises; eight true commendations
1800.construction:
aṭṭha + yathābhucca + vaṇṇa + ā
aṭṭhayathābhuccavaṇṇa + ā

examples.text: vipassissa, bhikkhave, bhagavato arahato sammāsambuddhassa tayo sāvakānaṃ sannipātā ahesuṃ. eko sāvakānaṃ sannipāto ahosi aṭṭhasaṭṭhibhikkhusatasahassaṃ, eko sāvakānaṃ sannipāto ahosi bhikkhusatasahassaṃ, eko sāvakānaṃ sannipāto ahosi asītibhikkhusahassāni.

1804.meaning1: six million eight hundred thousand monks (6 800 000)
1804.meaning2: six million eight hundred thousand monks (6 800 000)
1804.commentary: (SNt) aṭṭhasaṭṭhi-bhikkhusatasahassan'ti bhikkhūnaṃ satasahassañ'c'eva saṭṭhisahassāni ca aṭṭha ca sahassāni.

examples.text: vipassissa, bhikkhave, bhagavato arahato sammāsambuddhassa tayo sāvakānaṃ sannipātā ahesuṃ. eko sāvakānaṃ sannipāto ahosi aṭṭhasaṭṭhi-bhikkhusatasahassaṃ, eko sāvakānaṃ sannipāto ahosi bhikkhusatasahassaṃ, eko sāvakānaṃ sannipāto ahosi asītibhikkhusahassāni.
iti evarūpāni atītāni chattiṃsa taṇhāvicaritāni, anāgatāni chattiṃsa taṇhāvicaritāni, paccuppannāni chattiṃsa taṇhāvicaritāni. evaṃ aṭṭhasataṃ taṇhāvicaritaṃ honti.
tasmiṃ pana divase ekena ūnaṃ aṭṭhasataṃ yojenti.

1806.meaning1: discourse on the one hundred and eight; one hundred and eight ways
1806.commentary: (SNa) aṭṭhasatapariyāyan'ti aṭṭhasatassa kāraṇabhūtaṃ. (SNt) vedanānaṃ aṭṭh'ādhikaṃ sataṃ, tassa aṭṭhasatassa tabbhāvassa pariyāyo kāraṇaṃ ettha atthī'ti aṭṭhasatapariyāyo, suttaṃ. ten'āha aṭṭhasatassa kāraṇabhūtan'ti.

examples.text: atītā chattiṃsa vedanā, anāgatā chattiṃsa vedanā, paccuppannā chattiṃsa vedanā, imā vuccanti, bhikkhave, aṭṭhasataṃ vedanā. ayaṃ, bhikkhave, aṭṭhasatapariyāyo dhammapariyāyo'ti.

1807.meaning2: Chapter 3 of the Vedanāsaṃyuttaṃ, Book 4 of the Saṃyutta Nikāya
1807.meaningLit: section on the one hundred and eight ways

1808.meaning1: what is called one hundred and eight

examples.text: anantā hi asadisataṇhā-māna-diṭṭhibhedā sattā. aṭṭhasataṃ taṇhāvicaritaṃ hontī'ti ettha pana aṭṭhasatasaṅkhātaṃ taṇhāvicaritaṃ hotī'ti evam'attho daṭṭhabbo.

1809.meaningLit: discourse on one hundred and eight

examples.text: ayaṃ me, bhante, bāhitikā raññā māgadhena ajātasattunā vedehiputtena vatthanāḷiyā pakkhipitvā pahitā soḷasasamā āyāmena, aṭṭhasamā vitthārena.

1813.meaning2: connected with eight bases or grounds

1815.meaning1: living for eight thousand years; with a lifespan of eight thousand years

examples.text: cattārivassasahass'āyukānaṃ manussānaṃ aṭṭhavassasahass'āyukā puttā bhavissanti…

aṭṭhavidhena māno, lābhena mānaṃ janeti, alābhena omānaṃ janeti, yasena mānaṃ janeti, ayasena omānaṃ janeti, pasaṃsāya mānaṃ janeti, nindāya omānaṃ janeti, sukhena mānaṃ janeti, dukkhena omānaṃ janeti.

1819.meaning1: the four jhānas and the four formless attainments

examples.text: idañ'ca pana vatvā idaṃ suttaṃ āhari, katamo ca puggalo ubhatobhāgavimutto. idh'ekacco puggalo aṭṭhavimokkhe kāyena phusitvā viharati, paññāya c'assa disvā āsavā parikkhīṇā honti, ayaṃ vuccati puggalo ubhatobhāgavimutto'ti.
aṭṭhavīse kappasate, rājā saṃvasito ahuṃ, sattaratanasampanno, cakkavattī mahabbalo.

1821.commentary: (PMa) aṭṭhavīsati dhammā'ti purimā ca cuddasa, ime ca cuddasā'ti aṭṭhavīsati. idha rūpassā'pi paviṭṭhattā sampayuttapaccayaṃ apanetvā vippayuttapaccayo vutto.

examples.text: dve sampattī anubhotvā, vaḍḍhetvā puññasañcayaṃ, aṭṭhavīsatikappamhi, cakkavattī bhavissati.

paṭisandhikkhaṇe ime aṭṭhavīsati dhammā sahajātapaccayā honti, aññam'aññapaccayā honti, nissayapaccayā honti, vippayuttapaccayā honti. khattiyamahāsālānaṃ brāhmaṇamahāsālānaṃ gahapatimahāsālānaṃ kāmāvacarānaṃ devānaṃ ñāṇasampayutte imesaṃ aṭṭhannaṃ hetūnaṃ paccayā upapatti hoti.
rājā mahāvijito imehi aṭṭhah'aṅgehi samannāgato. iti imāni'pi aṭṭh'aṅgāni tass'eva yaññassa parikkhārā bhavanti.
anujānāmi, bhikkhave, aṭṭhah'aṅgehi samannāgataṃ bhikkhuṃ bhikkhun'ovādakaṃ sammannituṃ.

1826.grammar: card, x instr pl of aṭṭha

examples.text: ovadeyyā'ti aṭṭhahi garudhammehi ovadati, āpatti pācittiyassa. aññena dhammena ovadati, āpatti dukkaṭassa. ekatoupasampannaṃ ovadati, āpatti dukkaṭassa.

1827.commentary: (JAa) aṭṭhaṃsā'ti tava vasanapāsādesu aṭṭhaṃsā sukatā veḷuriyamayā thambhā. tehi thambhehi sahassathambhā tava pāsādā nāgakaññāhi pūrā vijjotanti.

examples.text: seyyathā'pi nāma maṇi veḷuriyo subho jātimā aṭṭh'aṃso suparikammakato paṇḍukambale nikkhitto bhāsate ca tapate ca virocati ca
aṭṭhaṃsā sukatā thambhā, sabbe veḷuriyāmayā, yattha devā tāvatiṃsā, sabbe indapurohitā.

atha kho sambahulā sat'ullapakāyikā devatāyo abhikkantāya rattiyā abhikkantavaṇṇā kevalakappaṃ jetavanaṃ obhāsetvā yena bhagavā ten'upasaṅkamiṃsu, upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekam'antaṃ aṭṭhaṃsu.
aṭṭhānam'etaṃ, bhikkhave, anavakāso yaṃ tathāgato aparisuddhāya parisāya uposathaṃ kareyya, pātimokkhaṃ uddiseyya

aṭṭhānam'etaṃ, āvuso, anavakāso yaṃ mettāya cetovimuttiyā bhāvitāya bahulīkatāya yānīkatāya vatthukatāya anuṭṭhitāya paricitāya susamāraddhāya, atha ca pan'assa byāpādo cittaṃ pariyādāya ṭhassati, n'etaṃ ṭhānaṃ vijjati.

1831.commentary: (NIDD1a) aṭṭhāne vā pana kodho jāyatī'ti akāraṇe kodho uppajjati. ekacco hi devo ativassatī'ti kuppati, na vassatī'ti kuppati, sūriyo tappatī'ti kuppati, na tappatī'ti kuppati, vāte vāyantepi kuppati, avāyantepi kuppati, sammajjituṃ asakkonto bodhipaṇṇānaṃ kuppati, cīvaraṃ pārupituṃ asakkonto vātassa kuppati, upakkhalitvā khāṇukassa kuppati. idaṃ sandhāya vuttaṃ, aṭṭhāne vā pana kodho jāyatī'ti. tattha heṭṭhā navasu ṭhānesu satte ārabbha uppannattā kammapathabhedo hoti.

examples.text: piyassa me manāpassa anatthaṃ acarī'ti … anatthaṃ caratī'ti … anatthaṃ carissatī'ti āghātaṃ bandhati, appiyassa me amanāpassa atthaṃ acarī'ti … atthaṃ caratī'ti … atthaṃ carissatī'ti āghātaṃ bandhati, aṭṭhāne ca kuppati, imāni kho, bhikkhave, dasa āghātavatthūnī'ti.
kacci taṃ, bho gotama, dānaṃ petānaṃ ñātisālohitānaṃ upakappati, kacci te petā ñātisālohitā taṃ dānaṃ paribhuñjantī'ti? ṭhāne kho, brāhmaṇa, upakappati, no aṭṭhāne'ti.

1832.meaning1: fact of understanding what is not possible
1832.commentary: (DNa) aṭṭhānakusalatā'ti ye ye dhammā yesaṃ yesaṃ dhammānaṃ na hetū na paccayā uppādāya taṃ taṃ aṭṭhānan'ti yā tattha paññā pajānanā'ti (dha. sa. 1345) evaṃ vuttā cakkhuṃ vatthuṃ katvā rūpaṃ ārammaṇaṃ katvā sotaviññāṇ'ādīni n'uppajjanti, tasmā tesaṃ cakkhurūpaṃ na ṭhānaṃ na kāraṇan'ti evaṃ aṭṭhānaparicchindanasamatthā paññā.

examples.text: ṭhānakusalatā ca aṭṭhānakusalatā ca.

1833.meaning1: not gone to good use; not gone to a good cause; gone to waste
1833.commentary: (ANa) ṭhānagataṃ hotī'ti kāraṇagataṃ hoti. kiṃ pana tanti? catūsu pattakammesu ekaṃ bhogehi kattabbakammaṃ bhogajātam'eva ṭhānagataṃ.

examples.text: yassa kassaci, gahapati, aññatra imehi catūhi pattakammehi bhogā parikkhayaṃ gacchanti, ime vuccanti, gahapati, bhogā aṭṭhānagatā apattagatā anāyatanaso paribhuttā.

1835.grammar: fem, abstr, from na ṭhāna, neg
1835.construction:
na > a + √ṭhā + ana + tā
aṭṭhāna + tā

examples.text: atha kho jayaseno rājakumāro aciravatassa samaṇ'uddesassa aṭṭhānatañ'ca anavakāsatañ'ca pavedetvā uṭṭhāy'āsanā pakkāmi.

1836.grammar: nt, abl sg of na ṭhāna, neg
1836.construction:
na > a + √ṭhā + ana + to
aṭṭhāna + to

examples.text: idha, bhikkhave, tathāgato ṭhānañ'ca ṭhānato aṭṭhānañ'ca aṭṭhānato yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti.

1837.meaning1: thinking of the impossible; assumption of an impossibility
1837.commentary: (MNt) aṭṭhānaparikappenā'ti akāraṇassa vatthuno parikappanena tadā asambhavantaṃ atthaṃ parikappetvā vacanena.

examples.text: evaṃ pariharantā pana icchit'icchitakkhaṇe'y'eva sīsato oropetvā mah'ārahe āsane nisīdāpetvā sakkā honti pañhaṃ vā pucchituṃ dhammaṃ vā sotuṃ. iti aṭṭhānaparikappena abhiṇhadassanassa upāyaṃ dassesi.
idāni aṭṭhānaparikappaṃ dassento nabhaṃ phaleyyā'ti-ādim'āha.

1839.meaning1: this is impossible; this cannot happen

examples.text: aṭṭhānam'etaṃ, bhikkhave, anavakāso yaṃ tathāgato aparisuddhāya parisāya uposathaṃ kareyya, pātimokkhaṃ uddiseyya

aṭṭhānam'etaṃ, āvuso, anavakāso yaṃ mettāya cetovimuttiyā bhāvitāya bahulīkatāya yānīkatāya vatthukatāya anuṭṭhitāya paricitāya susamāraddhāya, atha ca pan'assa byāpādo cittaṃ pariyādāya ṭhassati, n'etaṃ ṭhānaṃ vijjati.

1841.commentary: (MNa) aṭṭhāpadakatā'ti ras'odakena makkhitvā nalāṭapariyante āvattanaparivatte katvā aṭṭhapadakaracanāya racitā.

examples.text: aṭṭhāpadakatā kesā, nettā añjanamakkhitā, alaṃ bālassa mohāya, no ca pāragavesino.

1842.commentary: (MNa) upavicāravasena cakkhunā rūpaṃ disvā somanassaṭṭhāniyaṃ rūpaṃ upavicaratī'tiādikā aṭṭhārasa

examples.text: cha ajjhattikāni āyatanāni veditabbāni, cha bāhirāni āyatanāni veditabbāni, cha viññāṇakāyā veditabbā, cha phassakāyā veditabbā, aṭṭhārasa mano'pavicārā veditabbā, chattiṃsa sattapadā veditabbā
aṭṭhārasā'pi mayā vedanā vuttā pariyāyena, chattiṃsā'pi mayā vedanā vuttā pariyāyena, aṭṭhasatam'pi mayā vedanā vuttā pariyāyena.

1845.meaning1: eighteen grounds for disunion; eighteen causes of dissension
1845.construction:
aṭṭhārasa + bhedakara + vatthu + ūni
aṭṭhārasabhedakaravatthu + ūni

examples.text: bhedanasaṃvattanikaṃ vā adhikaraṇan'ti aṭṭhārasabhedakaravatthūni.

1847.commentary: (MNt) cakkhunā rūpaṃ disvā somanassaṭṭhāniyaṃ rūpaṃ upavicaratī'ti-ādinā (dī. ni. 3.324) vuttānaṃ channaṃ somanass'ūpavicārānaṃ, channaṃ domanassa-upekkh'ūpavicārānañ'ca vasena aṭṭhārasamano'pavicāro.

examples.text: chadhāturo ayaṃ, bhikkhu, puriso chaphass'āyatano aṭṭhārasamano'pavicāro catur'ādhiṭṭhāno, yattha ṭhitaṃ maññ'assavā nappavattanti, maññ'assave kho pana nappavattamāne muni santo'ti vuccati.

evañ'ca pana bhikkhave dātabbā. tāya aṭṭhārasavassāya kumāribhūtāya saṅghaṃ upasaṅkamitvā ek'aṃsaṃ uttar'āsaṅgaṃ karitvā bhikkhunīnaṃ pāde vanditvā ukkuṭikaṃ nisīditvā añjaliṃ paggahetvā evam'assa vacanīyo
tatra'pi evaṃ aṭṭhāsiṃ evaṃ nisīdiṃ evaṃ abhāsiṃ evaṃ tuṇhī ahosiṃ
sāvatthiyaṃ piṇḍāya caritvā pacchābhattaṃ piṇḍapātapaṭikkantā yena andhavanaṃ ten'upasaṅkami divāvihārāya. andhavanaṃ ajjhogāhetvā aññatarasmiṃ supupphitasālarukkhamūle aṭṭhāsi.
so bhikkhu bhikkhūhi evam'assa vacanīyo, m'āyasmā samaggassa saṅghassa bhedāya parakkami, bhedanasaṃvattanikaṃ vā adhikaraṇaṃ samādāya paggayha aṭṭhāsi

1851.meaning1: eight days; period of eight days

examples.text: alaṃ, bho satta, āhato me sāli saki'd'eva cat'ūhāyā'ti. atha kho so, vāseṭṭha, satto tassa sattassa diṭṭh'ānugatiṃ āpajjamāno sāliṃ āhāsi saki'd'eva aṭṭh'āhāya, evam'pi kira, bho, sādhū'ti.

1852.meaning1: which appeared on the eighth day; which becomes available on the seventh day after

examples.text: aṭṭh'āh'uppanne mūlacīvare paccāsācīvaraṃ uppajjati, das'āhā kāretabbaṃ.
yān'imāni apatthāni, alābūn'eva sārade, kāpotakāni aṭṭhīni, tāni disvāna kā rati.
atthi imasmiṃ kāye kesā lomā nakhā dantā taco, maṃsaṃ nhāru aṭṭhi aṭṭhimiñjaṃ vakkaṃ, hadayaṃ yakanaṃ kilomakaṃ pihakaṃ papphāsaṃ

1854.commentary: (MNa) aṭṭhiṃ katvā'ti atthikabhāvaṃ katvā, atthiko hutvā'ti attho. (SNa) aṭṭhiṃ katvā'ti attānaṃ tena dhammena aṭṭhikaṃ katvā, taṃ vā dhammaṃ, esa mayhaṃ attho'ti aṭṭhiṃ katvā.

examples.text: tassa te, āvuso, alābhā, tassa te dulladdhaṃ, yaṃ tvaṃ pātimokkhe uddissamānena na sādhukaṃ aṭṭhiṃ katvā manasi karosī'ti, idaṃ tasmiṃ mohanake pācittiyaṃ.
te'dha bhikkhū aṭṭhiṃ katvā, manasi katvā, sabbaṃ cetaso samannāharitvā, ohitasotā dhammaṃ suṇanti.

1855.meaning1: (of a fruit) kernel; pip; stone; hard seed

examples.text: sāsapamattiyo hutvā muggamattiyo ahesuṃ, muggamattiyo hutvā kalāyamattiyo ahesuṃ, kalāyamattiyo hutvā kol'aṭṭhimattiyo ahesuṃ, kol'aṭṭhimattiyo hutvā kolamattiyo ahesuṃ, kolamattiyo hutvā āmalakamattiyo ahesuṃ
puna caparaṃ, bhikkhave, bhikkhu seyyathā'pi passeyya sarīraṃ sivathikāya chaḍḍitaṃ aṭṭhikasaṅkhalikaṃ samaṃsalohitaṃ nhārusambandhaṃ
puna caparaṃ, bhikkhave, tam'eva bhaginiṃ passeyya sarīraṃ sivathikāya chaḍḍitaṃ, aṭṭhikāni setāni saṅkhavaṇṇapaṭibhāgāni, aṭṭhikāni puñjakitāni terovassikāni, aṭṭhikāni pūtīni cuṇṇakajātāni.

1858.commentary: (MNa) aṭṭhikaṅkalan'ti ur'aṭṭhiṃ vā piṭṭhikaṇṭakaṃ vā sīsaṭṭhiṃ vā. tañ'hi nimmaṃsattā kaṅkalanti vuccati. (ITIa) aṭṭhikaṅkalo'ti aṭṭhibhāgo. aṭṭhikhalo'ti'pi paṭhan'ti, aṭṭhisañcayo'ti attho.

examples.text: app'assādā kāmā vuttā bhagavatā bahudukkhā bah'upāyāsā, ādīnavo ettha bhiyyo. aṭṭhikaṅkala-upamā kāmā vuttā bhagavatā bahudukkhā bah'upāyāsā, ādīnavo ettha bhiyyo.
tam'enaṃ dakkho goghātako vā goghātak'antevāsī vā aṭṭhikaṅkalaṃ sunikkantaṃ nikkantaṃ nimmaṃsaṃ lohitamakkhitaṃ upasumbheyya.

1859.meaning1: like a skeleton; similar to a skeleton

examples.text: evam'eva kho, gahapati, ariyasāvako iti paṭisañcikkhati, aṭṭhikaṅkal'ūpamā kāmā vuttā bhagavatā, bahudukkhā bah'upāyāsā, ādīnavo ettha bhiyyo'ti.
app'assādā kāmā vuttā bhagavatā bahudukkhā bah'upāyāsā, ādīnavo ettha bhiyyo. aṭṭhikaṅkal'ūpamā kāmā vuttā bhagavatā bahudukkhā bah'upāyāsā, ādīnavo ettha bhiyyo.

1860.grammar: abs of aṭṭhiṃ karoti, comp vb
1860.commentary: (JAa) aṭṭhikatvā'ti attano atthikabhāvaṃ katvā atthiko hutvā sakkaccaṃ suṇeyya.

examples.text: nātike piṇḍāya caritvā pacchābhattaṃ piṇḍapātapaṭikkanto pāde pakkhāletvā giñjakāvasathaṃ pavisitvā māgadhake paricārake ārabbha aṭṭhikatvā manasikatvā sabbacetasā samannāharitvā paññatte āsane nisīdi, gatiṃ nesaṃ jānissāmi abhisamparāyaṃ, yaṃgatikā te bhavanto yaṃabhisamparāyā'ti.
gāthā imā atthavatī subyañjanā, subhāsitā isinā paṇḍitena, yo kocimā aṭṭhikatvā suṇeyya, labhetha pubb'āpariyaṃ visesaṃ, laddhāna pubb'āpariyaṃ visesaṃ, adassanaṃ maccurājassa gacche.

1861.meaningLit: discourse on great benefit of (meditation on) bones

examples.text: puna caparaṃ, bhikkhave, bhikkhu seyyathā'pi passeyya sarīraṃ sivathikāya chaḍḍitaṃ aṭṭhikasaṅkhalikaṃ samaṃsalohitaṃ nhārusambandhaṃ

1864.meaning1: perception of bone; concept of a skeleton
1864.commentary: (SNa) aṭṭhikasaññā'ti aṭṭhikaṃ aṭṭhikan'ti bhāventassa uppannasaññā. taṃ pan'etaṃ bhāvayato yāva nimittaṃ na uppajjati, tāva chavi'pi cammam'pi upaṭṭhāti. nimitte pana uppanne chavicammāni n'eva upaṭṭhahanti, saṅkhavaṇṇo suddha-aṭṭhikasaṅghāṭo'va upaṭṭhāti hatthikkhandhagataṃ dhammikatissarājānaṃ olokentassa sāmaṇerassa viya, paṭimagge hasamānaṃ itthiṃ olokentassa cetiyapabbatavāsino tissattherassa viya cā'ti. vatthūni visuddhimagge (visuddhi. 1.15) vitthāritāni.

examples.text: katamañ'c'āvuso, anurakkhaṇāpadhānaṃ? idh'āvuso, bhikkhu uppannaṃ bhadrakaṃ samādhinimittaṃ anurakkhati, aṭṭhikasaññaṃ, puḷuvakasaññaṃ, vinīlakasaññaṃ, vicchiddakasaññaṃ, uddhumātakasaññaṃ.
aṭṭhikasaññāya, bhikkhave, bhāvitāya bahulīkatāya dvinnaṃ phalānaṃ aññataraṃ phalaṃ pāṭikaṅkhaṃ, diṭṭh'eva dhamme aññā, sati vā upādisese anāgāmitā.

1865.meaning1: accompanied by the perception of bones; together with the perception of a skeleton

examples.text: kathaṃ bhāvitā ca, bhikkhave, aṭṭhikasaññā kathaṃ bahulīkatā mahapphalā hoti mah'ānisaṃsā? idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhu aṭṭhikasaññāsahagataṃ satisambojjh'aṅgaṃ bhāveti vivekanissitaṃ virāganissitaṃ nirodhanissitaṃ vossaggapariṇāmiṃ …

1866.grammar: abs of aṭṭhiṃ karoti, comp vb
1866.commentary: (VINa) aṭṭhiṃ katvā'ti atthikabhāvaṃ katvā, atthiko hutvā'ti vuttaṃ hoti. (MNa) aṭṭhiṃ katvā'ti atthikabhāvaṃ katvā, atthiko hutvā'ti attho.

1868.meaning2: who breaks bones; one with broken bones (?)
1868.commentary: (MNa) aṭṭhicchinnā'ti ayaṃ gāthā jātake (jā. 1.9.16) āgatā, brahmadattañ'ca dīghāvukumārañ'ca sandhāya vuttā. ayañ'h'ettha attho, tesam'pi tathā pavattaverānaṃ hoti saṅgati, kasmā tumhākaṃ na hoti, yesaṃ vo n'eva mātāpitūnaṃ aṭṭhīni chinnāni, na pāṇā haṭā na gav'āssadhanāni haṭānī'ti.

examples.text: aṭṭhicchinnā pāṇaharā, gav'assa-dhana-hārino, raṭṭhaṃ vilumpamānānaṃ, tesam'pi hoti saṅgati, kasmā tumhākaṃ no siyā.

1870.commentary: (DNa) aṭṭhitadhammā'ti naṭṭhitasabhāvā. jivhā no atthī'ti yaṃ yaṃ icchanti, taṃ taṃ kathenti, kadāci maggaṃ kathenti, kadāci phalaṃ kadāci nibbānan'ti adhippāyo.

examples.text: ṭhānaṃ kho pan'etaṃ, cunda, vijjati yaṃ aññatitthiyā paribbājakā evaṃ vadeyyuṃ, aṭṭhitadhammā samaṇā sakyaputtiyā viharantī'ti.

1871.commentary: (MNa) tuvam'aṭṭhito'sī'ti pāṇesu asaññatattā ettakāni pāṇasahassāni ghātentassa tava mettā vā khanti vā paṭisaṅkhā vā avihiṃsā vā sāraṇīyadhammo vā n'atthi, tasmā tuvaṃ aṭṭhito'si, idāni iriyāpathena ṭhito'pi niraye dhāvissasi, tiracchānayoniyaṃ pettivisaye asurakāye vā dhāvissasī'ti vuttaṃ hoti.

examples.text: gacchaṃ vadesi samaṇa ṭhito'mhi, mamañ'ca brūsi ṭhitam'aṭṭhito'ti, pucchāmi taṃ samaṇa etam'atthaṃ, kathaṃ ṭhito tvaṃ aham'aṭṭhito'mhī'ti.

1873.meaning1: doctrinally inconsistent; having a self-contradictory teaching
1873.commentary: (DNa) aṭṭhitadhammā'ti naṭṭhitasabhāvā. jivhā no atthī'ti yaṃ yaṃ icchanti, taṃ taṃ kathenti, kadāci maggaṃ kathenti, kadāci phalaṃ kadāci nibbānan'ti adhippāyo.

examples.text: ṭhānaṃ kho pan'etaṃ, cunda, vijjati yaṃ aññatitthiyā paribbājakā evaṃ vadeyyuṃ, aṭṭhitadhammā samaṇā sakyaputtiyā viharantī'ti.

1874.commentary: (MNa) aṭṭhitavatan'ti aṭṭhitatapaṃ, assa padhānapadena saddhiṃ sambandho, tathā sappurisapadassa. idañ'hi vuttaṃ hoti, bhoto gotamassa aṭṭhitapadhānavataṃ ahosi, sappurisapadhānavataṃ ahosī'ti.

examples.text: evaṃ vutte, saṅgāravo māṇavo bhagavantaṃ etadavoca, aṭṭhitavataṃ bhoto gotamassa padhānaṃ ahosi, sappurisavataṃ bhoto gotamassa padhānaṃ ahosi, yathā taṃ arahato sammāsambuddhassa.

1875.grammar: ind, adv, acc sg of aṭṭhita
1875.synonym: aparāparaṃ, dhuvaṃ, niccakappaṃ, niccaṃ, nibaddhaṃ, satataṃ, samitaṃ

examples.text: te c'āpi nūnappajaheyyu dukkhaṃ, ye tvaṃ muni aṭṭhitaṃ ovadeyya, taṃ taṃ namassāmi samecca nāga, app'eva maṃ bhagavā aṭṭhitaṃ ovadeyya.

1877.meaning1: heap of bones; pile of bones

examples.text: anamataggo'yaṃ, bhikkhave, saṃsāro … ekapuggalassa, bhikkhave, kappaṃ sandhāvato saṃsarato siyā evaṃ mahā aṭṭhikaṅkalo aṭṭhipuñjo aṭṭhirāsi yath'āyaṃ vepullo pabbato, sace saṃhārako assa, sambhatañ'ca na vinasseyya. taṃ kissa hetu?
yo pana bhikkhu aṭṭhimayaṃ vā dantamayaṃ vā visāṇamayaṃ vā sūcigharaṃ kārāpeyya, bhedanakaṃ pācittiyaṃ.

aṭṭh'imāni, bhikkhave, abhibh'āyatanāni. katamāni aṭṭha? ajjhattaṃ rūpasaññī eko bahiddhā rūpāni passati parittāni suvaṇṇadubbaṇṇāni, tāni abhibhuyya jānāmi passāmī'ti, evaṃsaññī hoti. idaṃ paṭhamaṃ abhibh'āyatanaṃ.
aṭṭh'imāni, bhikkhave, kusītavatthūni. katamāni aṭṭha?

1881.commentary: (PMa) aṭṭhimiñjā tesaṃ tesaṃ aṭṭhīnaṃ abbhantare ṭhitā miñjā.

examples.text: atthi imasmiṃ kāye kesā lomā nakhā dantā taco, maṃsaṃ nhāru aṭṭhi aṭṭhimiñjaṃ vakkaṃ, hadayaṃ yakanaṃ kilomakaṃ pihakaṃ papphāsaṃ
yaṃ kiñci, rāhula, ajjhattaṃ paccattaṃ kakkhaḷaṃ kharigataṃ upādinnaṃ, seyyath'idaṃ, kesā lomā nakhā dantā taco, maṃsaṃ nhāru aṭṭhi aṭṭhimiñjaṃ vakkaṃ… ayaṃ vuccati, rāhula, ajjhattikā pathavīdhātu

1882.commentary: (PMa) aṭṭhimiñjā tesaṃ tesaṃ aṭṭhīnaṃ abbhantare ṭhitā miñjā.

examples.text: atthi imasmiṃ kāye kesā lomā nakhā dantā taco maṃsaṃ nhāru aṭṭhi aṭṭhimiñjaṃ vakkaṃ hadayaṃ yakanaṃ kilomakaṃ
aṭṭh'ime, bhikkhave, hetū aṭṭha paccayā ādibrahmacariyikāya paññāya appaṭiladdhāya paṭilābhāya, paṭiladdhāya bhiyyobhāvāya vepullāya bhāvanāya pāripūriyā saṃvattanti. katame aṭṭha?

1884.synonym: attha, atthika, atthī, anugiddha, apekkha, abhijjhāyanta, ākaṅkhanta, ākaṅkhamāna, iccha, icchaka, icchanta, icchamāna, kāmaka, kāmayamāna, kāmayāna, kāmī, chādayamāna, jappanta, jigiṃsanta, jigiṃsāna, jigīsaka, jigīsanta, jigīsamāna, jigīsāna

examples.text: sītavātaparittānaṃ, hirikopīnachādanaṃ, matt'aṭṭhiyaṃ abhuñjiṃsu, santuṭṭhā itarītare.

1885.meaning1: heap of bones; pile of bones

examples.text: ekapuggalassa, bhikkhave, kappaṃ sandhāvato saṃsarato siyā evaṃ mahā aṭṭhikaṅkalo aṭṭhipuñjo aṭṭhirāsi yath'āyaṃ vepullo pabbato, sace saṃhārako assa, sambhatañ'ca na vinasseyyā'ti. etam'atthaṃ bhagavā avoca.

1886.meaning2: bone (or small pebble) used for massage

1891.meaning2: idea of bones; contemplation of the bones

1894.meaning1: pierced by a stroke as deep as the bone

examples.text: puna caparaṃ, bhikkhave, idh'ekacco bhadro ass'ājānīyo na h'eva kho patodacchāyaṃ disvā saṃvijjati saṃvegaṃ āpajjati n'āpi lomavedhaviddho saṃvijjati saṃvegaṃ āpajjati n'āpi cammavedhaviddho saṃvijjati saṃvegaṃ āpajjati, api ca kho aṭṭhivedhaviddho saṃvijjati saṃvegaṃ āpajjati, kiṃ nu kho maṃ ajja assadammasārathi kāraṇaṃ kāressati, kim'ass'āhaṃ paṭikaromī'ti!

1895.grammar: idiom, masc + abs, abs of aṭṭhiṃ karoti
1895.commentary: (VINa) aṭṭhiṃ katvā'ti atthikabhāvaṃ katvā, atthiko hutvā'ti vuttaṃ hoti.

examples.text: tassa te, āvuso, alābhā, tassa te dulladdhaṃ, yaṃ tvaṃ pātimokkhe uddissamānena na sādhukaṃ aṭṭhiṃ katvā manasi karosī'ti, idaṃ tasmiṃ mohanake pācittiyaṃ.
te'dha bhikkhū aṭṭhiṃ katvā, manasi katvā, sabbaṃ cetaso samannāharitvā, ohitasotā dhammaṃ suṇanti.

1896.grammar: abs of aṭṭhiṃ karoti, comp vb
1896.commentary: (VINa) aṭṭhiṃ katvā'ti atthikabhāvaṃ katvā, atthiko hutvā'ti vuttaṃ hoti. (MNa) aṭṭhiṃ katvā'ti atthikabhāvaṃ katvā, atthiko hutvā'ti attho.

examples.text: idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhu tathāgatappavedite dhammavinaye desiyamāne aṭṭhiṃkatvā manasi katvā sabbaṃ cetasā samannāharitvā ohitasoto dhammaṃ suṇāti. evaṃ kho, bhikkhave, bhikkhu sotā hoti.
balatā esā, bhikkhave, diṭṭhisampannassa puggalassa yaṃ tathāgatappavedite dhammavinaye desiyamāne aṭṭhiṃkatvā manasikatvā sabbacetasā samannāharitvā ohitasoto dhammaṃ suṇāti.

1897.commentary: (PMa) aṭṭhimiñjā tesaṃ tesaṃ aṭṭhīnaṃ abbhantare ṭhitā miñjā.

examples.text: seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, balavā puriso daḷhāya vāḷarajjuyā jaṅghaṃ veṭhetvā ghaṃseyya. sā chaviṃ chindeyya, chaviṃ chetvā cammaṃ chindeyya, cammaṃ chetvā maṃsaṃ chindeyya, maṃsaṃ chetvā nhāruṃ chindeyya, nhāruṃ chetvā aṭṭhiṃ chindeyya, aṭṭhiṃ chetvā aṭṭhiṃmiñjaṃ āhacca tiṭṭheyya.

1898.grammar: abs of aṭṭhiṃ karoti, comp vb, trans (+acc)
1898.meaning1: having focused; having given priority; having paid attention

examples.text: te'dha bhikkhū aṭṭhīkatvā manasi katvā sabbaṃ cetaso samannāharitvā ohitasotā dhammaṃ suṇanti.

1899.commentary: (SNa) kutassa aṭṭhīyakapiṇḍam'etī'ti assa sattassa aṭṭhiyakapiṇḍañ'ca kuto āgacchati? ettha ca aṭṭhiggahaṇena tīṇi aṭṭhisatāni, yakapiṇḍaggahaṇena nava maṃsapesisatāni gahitāni. yadi rūpaṃ na jīvo, ath'assa imāni ca aṭṭhīni imā ca maṃsapesiyo kuto āgacchantī'ti pucchati.

examples.text: rūpaṃ na jīvan'ti vadanti buddhā, kathaṃ nv'ayaṃ vindat'imaṃ sarīraṃ, kutassa aṭṭhīyakapiṇḍam'eti, kathaṃ nv'ayaṃ sajjati gabbharasmin'ti.
